content.short: Crypto payment gateway for businesses, with payouts, invoicing and savings vaults.
content.description: OMY Payments lets businesses accept any major coin and convert it instantly to fiat or stablecoins, cutting payment fees by up to 80% compared with card processors. The same account handles mass payouts to staff, contractors and affiliates from an uploaded address list, invoicing, and savings vaults that put idle balances into DeFi yield protocols.
content.meta: Accept crypto, pay out in bulk and earn yield on idle balances with OMY Payments, built on DeFi liquidity.
